Transfems are amabs who transition to present as feminine.

In contrast to [[trans men]] trans women have numerous issues related to hormones impairing their fertility. As such [[Bicalutamide‏‎]]  is often recommended as an alternative to hormones to preserve fertility, however it may be insufficient especially when combined with Estrogen which affects Leydig cells
